messages.author: ace9745b50e86915
messages.subject: model testing problem
parts:
Hi Daniel,

I pulled the newest stan and found something strange with model testing.
1. the number of parameters has been added by 3 for each model.

2. I am not able to test the dense matrix now. It seems that the problem is that in the output csv file, the covariance matrix will take d rows (instead of 1 row in the diagonal case) and the program is not able to read this format. Only those models with 1 parameter is able to be read normally. The previous model test version is fine but now it just won't work.

Could you help to fix these? Thank you.

Best,
Yuanjun
